global.description: Platform values (global.okdp): the context's layers, the platform's (platform.yaml) then its project's (project.yaml), never an instance's.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.description: Secrets to write. Each entry is one Kubernetes Secret: its credentials random values External Secrets Operator generates once in the cluster (generate), or keys it reads from the platform's secret store (remoteKey and properties), one or the other; its data keys static values (no credential). Each Secret stays in the instance's namespace. Names are unique.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the Kubernetes Secret to create.

generate.title: Generated keys
generate.description: The keys whose values are random, generated once in the cluster by an ESO Password generator each (never in Git, never rotated): key, length (default 32), digits (default 6), symbols (default 0), noUpper (default false), transform (sha256: the key holds the value's SHA-256 in hex, 64 characters; b64enc: its base64). A Secret is frozen once written: to change its keys, give it a new name. Not with remoteKey.

remoteKey.title: Key of the secret store
remoteKey.description: The key of the platform's secret store (global.okdp.secrets.store) the Secret's credentials are read from, every global.okdp.secrets.refreshInterval (1h), by an ExternalSecret: a path, segments separated by "/", under the instance's namespace (<namespace>/...): neither the platform's keys (platform/) nor another namespace's. Not with generate; needs properties.

properties.title: Properties read
properties.description: With remoteKey: the properties of the key read, each a key of the Secret of the same name (client_secret).

data.title: Static data
data.description: Keys of static values, no credential (a client_id, a username, a port), written as text beside the generated or read keys. Values cannot be empty; a key cannot also be generated or read.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Extra labels of the Secret, none under okdp.io/ (OKDP's) or replicator.v1.mittwald.de/. Database owner Secrets read by CloudNativePG managed roles need cnpg.io/reload: "true" (otherwise a role created before its Secret keeps no password).
